evaluation_name: Phase 63 Cross-Project Learning Multi-Tier Ablation Study

config_A_isolated.description: Baseline: Isolated repository, zero cross-project transfer

config_B_retrieval_only.description: Naive Transfer: Hybrid retrieval only, accepts candidates indiscriminately

config_C_retrieval_applicability.description: Gated Transfer: Retrieval + KnowledgeApplicabilityEngine structural filtering

config_D_full_closed_loop.description: Full Autonomous Learning: Retrieval + Applicability + Closed-Loop Feedback & Harm Detection

conclusions: Config A guarantees safety but sacrifices engineering reuse and test augmentation.
Config B (Naive) introduces severe regression noise (-0.04% coverage, 5 harm incidents).
Config C blocks 100% of structural incompatibilities via ApplicabilityEngine.
Config D achieves the highest evidence quality (0.96) and +9% coverage gain through closed feedback.
